notes: Strip x 7160-8770 with overlap 6860-9070. Suffixes 'Avenue' for Robertson, Leslie, Ida, Marsh, Dacey, Carland, Atlantic and Melrose (east part) read from 'AVE.' labels on the same street east of the strip. Smith Road: printed 'SMITH' on NW leg, 'ROAD' on the diagonal SE leg from the Forest junction, 'SMITH ROAD' on the N-S run south of Duck Creek Road. Duck Creek Road: printed 'DUCK CREEK' / 'ROAD' along the N-S and SW runs and 'DUCK CREEK' on the E-W run east of the junction. Edmonson and Williams: no suffix seen. Not streets: railroad and city-limit line along bottom edge, Duck Creek (the creek), Hyde Park Lumber Co. yard lanes, siding strip west of the big factory at x ~8900, grey/pink/orange/teal boundary bands, 'Norwood Syndicate Sub'n', 'Edw. Mills Sub.', 'Mary Stagge' lettering, key box. An unlabelled road tab leaves the bottom-left neat line at about (7900, 7000) heading SW; not recorded.
